title.es: El de cuando Cloe pide distancia
title.en: The One Where Cloe Asks for Distance

description.es: Marta apoya y aconseja a Andrés sobre su ruptura con Valentina. Más tarde, al preguntar a Cloe por su supuesta cita, Cloe admite que fue una mentira y confiesa que sigue enamorada de Marta. Con sinceridad, le dice que no puede verla solo como amiga y que lo mejor es mantener distancia.
description.en: Marta supports and advises Andrés about his breakup with Valentina. Later, when she asks Cloe about her supposed date, Cloe admits it was a lie and confesses that she is still in love with Marta. Honestly, she tells her that she can't see her only as a friend and that it's best to keep her distance.
